definition: CNAME points to any hostname but not at the zone apex. Alias points to AWS resources, works at the apex, has free queries, and cannot target an EC2 DNS name.
How long resolvers cache a record. A high TTL means fewer queries and lower cost, but changes take longer to reach users. Remember: lower it before a migration.
Simple returns every value in the record with no health checks, and the client picks one. Multi-value returns up to eight healthy records. Remember: neither replaces a load balancer.
Latency sends each user to the AWS Region with the lowest latency for them. Geolocation routes by user country or continent. Remember: add a default record for unmatched locations.
Routes users to the nearest resource by distance. A positive bias from 1 to 99 grows the area served by a resource; a negative bias shrinks it.
Probe HTTP, HTTPS, or TCP endpoints. Healthy when over 18 percent of checkers get a 200 or 300 range status. String matching reads only the first 5,120 bytes.
Route 53 health checkers are on the public internet and cannot reach private resources. Create a CloudWatch metric and alarm, then a health check that monitors the alarm.

Inbound endpoint: on-premises DNS servers forward queries to it to resolve private hosted zones. Outbound endpoint: VPC resources resolve on-premises names through forwarding rules. Remember: inbound flows into AWS.
Store session data in ElastiCache or DynamoDB, not on the instance, so any instance can serve any user. Sticky sessions work but lose sessions when instances terminate.
A golden AMI has software preinstalled, so instances boot ready fast. User data runs scripts at boot for dynamic settings. Restore RDS and EBS from snapshots to skip data loading.
Web server tier serves HTTP requests behind a load balancer. Worker tier pulls tasks from an SQS queue for long-running background jobs. Beanstalk is free; pay only for resources.
Lets only your CloudFront distribution read a private S3 bucket, granted through a bucket policy for the CloudFront service principal. Replaces legacy OAI and supports SSE-KMS encrypted objects.
Lets CloudFront reach an ALB, NLB, or EC2 instance in private subnets over a private connection, so CloudFront becomes the only public entry point to the application.
Price Class All uses every edge location. Price Class 200 skips the most expensive regions. Price Class 100 uses only the cheapest: North America, Europe, and Israel.
Invalidation removes cached files before their TTL expires; the first 1,000 paths a month are free, and a wildcard counts as one path. Versioned file names are cheaper and preferred.
Global Accelerator gives two static anycast IPs and proxies TCP or UDP to endpoints without caching. CloudFront caches HTTP content at the edge. Choose Accelerator for gaming, IoT, or VoIP.
